digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration — OpenAI Responses API
propositions: pydantic-ai 1.107.2 can construct OpenAIResponsesModel via the openai-responses: prefix and will default openai: to Responses API in v2.0, but rebar has four blocking code sites that make openai-responses: unusable today
KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES, _pydantic_ai_known_providers, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS, and the openai:→openai-chat: normalizers must be updated before rebar can route to Responses API for hosted OpenAI

only hosted OpenAI (openai:/openai-chat:) is Responses-ready under pydantic-ai 1.107.2; custom base_url builders, gateway/openai, and third-party vendors (deepseek/grok/xai/groq/cerebras/moonshotai/heroku) have no Responses construction path in the current pin

contract tests in tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py parameterize identical assertions (structured output, streaming, tool calls, 429 retry, custom-base-URL routing) over both openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes using real pydantic-ai model construction with httpx.MockTransport
xai: and groq: cannot be tested without optional SDK extras (xai-sdk, groq) and vendor-side /v1/responses support remains unknown without API documentation research
